title: Particle Word
description: A word made of a thousand dots that scatter when you touch them — the KATAYABURI flagship.
usage: KATAYABURI is the shelf where the mold breaks on purpose. This one samples a word into points and gives every point a spring home and a fear of cursors. Change the word with the buttons, or the data-word attribute. It proves nothing, sells nothing, and is the part people will remember — which, occasionally, is the job.
a11y: The word also exists as plain text for assistive technology; the canvas is aria-hidden theatre. Under prefers-reduced-motion the dots assemble instantly and stay put — the word, without the weather.
